items.title: Basalt engine on one DGX Spark: over 2x vLLM single-stream on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, slower at 4 concurrent
items.summary: A community Basalt engine runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with all 24,576 experts resident on one DGX Spark. End-to-end single-stream throughput is more than twice vLLM, while vLLM is over 1.5x faster at four concurrent streams; method (temperature 0, 256 output tokens, two runs each, engines alternated) is stated.

doubt.pushback: Third-party summary of another author's forum post; numbers not independently reproduced, replies not read.

items.title: Beam 1.0 (501B MoE) fits a 128 GB DGX Spark at 99.9 GB via vector quantization, 25.23 tok/s decode
items.summary: A VQ GGUF of the 501B-parameter Beam 1.0 shrinks 1.0 TB of BF16 weights to 99.9 GB, with expert weights stored at about 1.5 to 1.625 bits each via codebook lookup in the ds4-dfm-rs engine. It reports 25.23 tok/s decode on one 128 GB Spark.

doubt.pushback: Quality loss from the quantization is not shown in the post; replies not read.

items.title: aci-cpp (llama.cpp fork) beats llama.cpp v1.0.0 on 8 of 10 Qwen3.8-27B workloads, up to 28%
items.summary: The Actual team benchmarks its llama.cpp fork against v1.0.0 on Qwen3.8-27B across Macs, DGX Spark and RTX cards: ahead on 8 of 10 workloads by up to 28%, with faster multi-token-prediction drafting and 250K-context decode on an M3 Ultra (12.6 tok/s, 46% faster than its prior build). A full write-up lists conditions per chart.

doubt.pushback: Vendor-run benchmark of its own fork; not independently reproduced.

items.title: Strata 0.2.20 adds full support for Unsloth quants of Inkling 2 Mini and faster small-GPU performance
items.summary: Strata 0.2.20 fixes bugs and improves speed on smaller GPUs and older devices, and now supports all Unsloth quantizations of Inkling 2 Mini.

items.title: Walkthrough: pointing an agent at T3 Code over one MCP link so it routes all coding to a single coding model
items.summary: A how-to thread for orchestrating a fleet of machines from one agent while T3 Code handles the coding, using a single MCP link and one routing rule. Setup description only; no repo or measured result.

doubt.pushback: Third-party setup description with no link to docs or result; claim only.

saved_rejected.reason: Vague tok/s reaction quoting an already-reported Strata release; no new capability.
